AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Shaman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performed rituals and ceremonies on an impromptu altar in {PAWN_gender ? his : her} village.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fisherman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fished for {PAWN_gender ? his : her} home village almost every day.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Salt gatherer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was collecting salt from the shore and doing evaporation.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gatherer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spends most of {PAWN_gender ? his : her} life in the forests near the village, foraging for plant food.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Hunter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] often roams the forest looking for small animals for {PAWN_gender ? his : her} village.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Archer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] patrols the village, helping the warriors to fight off the attacks of animals and neighbors.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Warrior
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is often chosen in raids against neighbors for personal gain.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Healer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The community loved [PAWN_nameDef] for {PAWN_gender ? his : her} healing skills. Even the most dangerous wounds can be handled by {PAWN_gender ? him : her}.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Marauder
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bloodthirsty assassin, at least that's how his surviving enemies remember {PAWN_gender ? him : her}.
